items.informal_name: Negation of a Symmetric Multivariate Polynomial is Symmetric
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {φ : MvPolynomial σ R}, φ.IsSymmetric → (-φ).IsSymmetric
items.informal_description: For any symmetric multivariate polynomial $\varphi$ over a commutative ring $R$, its negation $-\varphi$ is also symmetric.

items.informal_name: Invariance of Sign Variations Under Polynomial Negation
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] (P : Polynomial R),
  (-P).signVariations = P.signVariations
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ P $, the number of sign variations in $ -P $ is equal to the number of sign variations in $ P $, i.e., $ \operatorname{signVariations}(-P) = \operatorname{signVariations}(P) $.

items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : (α → ℕ) → ℤ}, IsPoly f → IsPoly (-f)
items.informal_description: If $ f $ is a polynomial (i.e., a function from exponent vectors $ \alpha \to \mathbb{N} $ to integers $ \mathbb{Z} $ with finite support), then its negation $ -f $ is also a polynomial.

items.informal_name: Negation Preserves Degrees of Multivariate Polynomials
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R), (-p).degrees = p.degrees
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $, the multiset of variables (degrees) in $ -p $ is equal to the multiset of variables in $ p $, i.e., $ (-p).\text{degrees} = p.\text{degrees} $.

items.informal_name: Polynomial Evaluation at Negative Natural Numbers in Non-Associative Rings
items.type:
∀ (S : Type u_3) [inst : NonAssocRing S] [inst_1 : Pow S ℕ] [NatPowAssoc S] (q : Polynomial ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  q.smeval (-↑n) = ↑(q.smeval (-↑n))
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ q $ with natural number coefficients and any natural number $ n $, evaluating $ q $ at the additive inverse of $ n $ in a non-associative ring $ S $ equipped with a compatible power operation yields the same result as evaluating $ q $ at the integer $ -n $. Formally, $ q.\text{smeval}(-n) = q.\text{smeval}(-n : \mathbb{Z}) $.

items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a : MvPolynomial σ R), (-a).totalDegree = a.totalDegree
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ a $, the total degree of $ -a $ is equal to the total degree of $ a $, i.e., $ \operatorname{totalDegree}(-a) = \operatorname{totalDegree}(a) $.
